findings.name: Root Account MFA Not Enabled
findings.description: The AWS root account does not have multi-factor authentication enabled. The root account has unrestricted access to every resource in the account.
findings.remediation: Sign in as root, open the IAM security credentials page and enable a hardware or virtual MFA device. Avoid using root for daily tasks.

findings.name: S3 Bucket Publicly Accessible
findings.description: Bucket 'kj-lab-public-assets' is publicly accessible via an AllUsers ACL grant with no Public Access Block configured.
findings.remediation: Enable S3 Block Public Access at the bucket and account level and remove the AllUsers ACL grant.

findings.name: IAM User with Administrator Privileges
findings.description: IAM user 'devops-dan' has the AdministratorAccess policy attached directly, violating least privilege.
findings.remediation: Replace AdministratorAccess with scoped policies and assume admin via an STS role with MFA.

findings.name: Console User Without MFA
findings.description: IAM user 'devops-dan' has console access but no MFA device registered.
findings.remediation: Enforce MFA via an aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent policy condition and register an MFA device.

findings.name: Security Group Allows Unrestricted SSH Access
findings.description: Security group 'sg-0a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8' permits inbound SSH (port 22) from 0.0.0.0/0, exposing the host to internet-wide brute force.
findings.remediation: Restrict the SSH rule to trusted CIDRs or use SSM Session Manager; remove the 0.0.0.0/0 ingress rule.

findings.name: Security Group Allows Unrestricted RDP Access
findings.description: Security group 'sg-0a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8' permits inbound RDP (port 3389) from 0.0.0.0/0.
findings.remediation: Restrict the RDP rule to trusted CIDRs or use a bastion; remove the 0.0.0.0/0 ingress rule.

findings.name: CloudTrail Not Enabled in All Regions
findings.description: No multi-region CloudTrail trail is actively logging; API activity in unmonitored regions goes unrecorded.
findings.remediation: Create a multi-region trail logging management events for all regions and confirm it is in the 'Logging' state.

findings.name: S3 Bucket Logging Not Enabled
findings.description: Bucket 'kj-lab-public-assets' does not have server access logging enabled, reducing forensic visibility.
findings.remediation: Enable server access logging and ship logs to a dedicated, access-restricted log bucket.

findings.name: S3 Default Encryption Not Enabled
findings.description: Bucket 'kj-lab-backups' has no default server-side encryption configured.
findings.remediation: Enable default encryption (SSE-S3 or SSE-KMS) and deny unencrypted PutObject via bucket policy.

findings.name: CloudTrail Log File Validation Disabled
findings.description: Trail 'kj-lab-trail' does not have log file integrity validation enabled.
findings.remediation: Enable log file validation so CloudTrail produces signed digest files for integrity verification.

findings.name: Access Key Not Rotated in 90 Days
findings.description: Access key 1 for user 'ci-bot' was last rotated more than 90 days ago.
findings.remediation: Rotate the access key and migrate to short-lived STS credentials where possible.

findings.name: Weak IAM Password Policy
findings.description: The account password policy is weak: minimum length < 14, symbols not required.
findings.remediation: Set a password policy requiring at least 14 characters with mixed character classes.

findings.name: S3 Bucket Versioning Disabled
findings.description: Bucket 'kj-lab-backups' does not have versioning enabled, so overwritten/deleted objects cannot be recovered.
findings.remediation: Enable versioning and consider MFA Delete plus lifecycle rules.

findings.name: Default Security Group Allows Inbound Traffic
findings.description: The default security group has inbound rules and is attached to workloads.
findings.remediation: Remove all rules from the default security group and use purpose-built SGs.
